title: $(a,a)$-Carmichael numbers and greatest common divisors of $p-a$
summary: Define an $(a,a)$-Carmichael number to be a squarefree natural number $n$ such that $p\mid n$ implies $p-a\mid n-a$. For such a number $n$ with prime factors $p_1,\cdots,p_m$, define $$K=GCD[p_1-a,\cdots,p_m-a],$$ and let $C_ν(X,a)$ denote the number of $(a,a)$-Carmichael numbers up to $X$ such that $K=ν$.
